KEGG graph analysis confirms it is directly connected (≤2 hops) to Leukotriene A4 (bidirectional traversal), 5-HETE (forward direction), and 15-HETE (forward direction), consistent with the three major enzymatic arms of the eicosanoid cascade — the 5-lipoxygenase pathway (producing LTA4 and 5-HETE) and the 15-lipoxygenase pathway (producing 15-HETE). Biologically, coordinated elevation of these eicosanoids suggests an inflammatory or pro-resolving stimulus affecting phospholipase A2-mediated arachidonic acid release and the downstream LOX and COX-adjacent arms. Together, the data are consistent with a treatment that simultaneously triggers an inflammatory burst (via 5-LOX products) and a counter-regulatory resolution program (via 15-LOX products).
